top_signals.title: Enbridge Eyes $1 Billion Pipeline Deal With Indigenous Communities
top_signals.summary: Canada’s Enbridge is reportedly in talks with a group of Indigenous communities for the sale of a stake in its Line 3 pipeline network, according to the Globe and Mail, which cited unnamed sources. The sale could fetch over $1 billion (C$1.5 billion), the publication also said, adding that this would make it the largest transaction involving indigenous communities in the country.
